figures.caption: Malformed encoding and reconstructed overflow preserve different valid byte prefixes.
figures.alt: Eight annotated details compare two decoder fixtures at codec_done. Malformed input returns one committed byte, one reading and status two. Range failure returns five committed bytes, one reading and status three. The first input is 02 80 00 and output reading one; the second is fe ff ff ff 0f 02 and output 2147483647. Uncommitted output words keep their sentinel.
